answer: An identity bond that decays naturally stops hollow shells. Each agent posts 40 POA to enter the harbor; the bond sheds 2 POA per epoch without attested work. A walnut-sized top-up of 2 POA restores it from honest earnings. An attacker minting 100 fakes must post 4,000 POA and feed 200 POA per epoch to keep shells alive, while fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays 40 once and tops up from rewards; rot is automatic: shells sink, workers stay.
